method.method: YouTube browser metadata and selected paused decoded frames; no full watch-through, complete transcript or interactive game test.
method.playlist_correction: The supplied playlist ID is valid and lists 17 episodes on this date; supersedes the earlier unverified/incomplete characterization.

excluded_samples.reason: YouTube ad appeared; not treated as gameplay evidence.
Buffering with stale previous frame; discarded.

limitations: Not uninterrupted watch-throughs or complete transcripts.
Recording versions unknown; do not equate with supplied APK 11.3.0.
Playlist membership may change. Dates are review dates, not publication dates.
No new screenshot assets or downloaded videos included. Earlier screenshots remain in the original pack.

observations.observation: Stage 1 grid of large gray block deposits with colored ore patches, scattered fragments and an avatar/cart close to the block face. Small carried-capacity display beneath avatar; task card at upper left.
observations.limit: Opening sampled state; not a first-time onboarding claim.

observations.inference: For an original prototype, discrete cell/deposit state is sufficient to express this feedback.
observations.observation: Cracked block faces next to an empty mined bay; avatar holds pickaxe near the wall. Removed sections interrupt a regular deposit grid.
observations.limit: A grid-like appearance does not establish the underlying terrain or destruction implementation.

observations.observation: Wide hub view shows separate SHOP and UPGRADE buildings, a locked kiosk, refinery machinery, three parked blue flatbed trucks, a SELL ground rectangle and a material-price board. One visible truck counter reads 0/3.
observations.limit: Truck counter and prices are screenshot-specific UI, not calibrated design constants. The sample does not establish whether all trucks depart or sell automatically.

observations.design_note: Diegetic zones make a hub readable; use original layout, labels and building silhouettes.
observations.observation: Physical hub buildings use labeled ground interaction rectangles: ENTER at SHOP and OPEN at UPGRADE. A green exclamation marker floats above Upgrade; an OIL kiosk remains locked and says rent fuel-powered equipment. A separate Speed Boost pad is visible beside heavy machinery.
observations.limit: Selected frame; no runtime behavior tested.

observations.observation: An extensively cleared Stage 1 area retains many loose rubble pieces. The player carries a tall red stack and shows a red MAX capacity cue.
observations.limit: The material identity and collection/full-capacity rules cannot be determined from this single frame.

observations.inference: Later machinery offers a distinct material-handling presentation from the avatar/pickaxe loop. The frame alone does not reveal solver, conveyors, fuel drain, AI or exact transfer logic.
observations.observation: A yellow front-blade vehicle is positioned in a loose-rubble lane directly above a receiving hopper/bin at a track-side edge; dense loose fragments and tire marks are visible.
observations.limit: Selected frame; no runtime behavior tested.

observations.observation: Stage 1 deposit grid; avatar mining with pickaxe/cart; yellow cargo bar; home/direction arrow shows 19 m. Task says Deliver Minerals to the Furnace.
observations.limit: Recorded early gameplay, not a complete onboarding sequence.

observations.observation: Cracked and removed deposit cells, home arrow 16 m and Break Rocky Ores task. Stage display remains 0% despite visible mined sections.
observations.limit: Stage-progress formula cannot be inferred from broken-cell count.

observations.observation: Hub has separate REFINE input pad and LOAD output tray, bar-shaped output, truck 1/3, UPGRADE building, locked OIL and WORKER buildings, plus PIZZA truck/picnic area.
observations.limit: A frame establishes station layout and labels; worker recovery rules and transfer algorithms remain unverified.

observations.observation: Mine corridors follow a curved rail track. A large spiked roller is parked near the mine; avatar with pickaxe works beside blue ore. Task says Go to Machinery.
observations.limit: Do not infer autonomous driving or the collision implementation.

observations.observation: Yellow articulated excavator-like machine works between block rows; orange OIL gauge and red exit-style icon visible. Rail-side bin reads CARGO; loose rubble fills the cleared area.
observations.limit: Fuel consumption rate, controls, and bin transfer trigger not established.

observations.observation: Stage 1 at 17%; excavator at a block face with an OIL gauge; large quantities of gray and colored rubble; visible track-side receiving bin.
observations.limit: Shows machinery plus debris workload, not measured fuel use or break rate.

observations.observation: Stage 1 at 21%; hub has tall stacks of differently colored processed bars, multiple trucks (one at 3/3), green currency effects near a loaded truck, WORKER building and picnic area.
observations.limit: A single frame suggests reward feedback; exact sale trigger and worker-rest rules are not established.

observations.observation: Stage 1 at 31%; Upgrade at Quarry task, SELL ground pad, long carried stack, currency effects and a truck display at 0/5.
observations.limit: Different truck capacity display from 3/3 earlier; do not infer exact upgrade schedule or prices.

observations.observation: Blue front-blade vehicle beside WORKER building's OPEN pad and picnic benches; task continues Upgrade at Quarry. Orange bar below vehicle.
observations.limit: Vehicle appearance and contextual pad visible; entry/exit, worker scheduling and controls not tested.

observations.observation: Level 1 portrait view with an excavator, a small cart/character nearby and green interaction-style marker.
observations.limit: Low-resolution sample: omit small text and exact stats.

observations.observation: Level 1 character carries a tall red stack; red MAX banner; yellow directional breadcrumbs extend ahead; home/distance cue below.
observations.limit: Breadcrumb destination/activation not established by one frame.

observations.observation: Level 2 yellow wheeled loader/hauler with a tall mixed-color cargo stack and MAX banner beside ore cells; tire tracks behind it.
observations.limit: Vehicle role is described visually; exact capacity and handling unknown.

observations.observation: Level 2 repeats loaded yellow vehicle with MAX, mixed rubble and curved tire tracks; a spiked machine is further up the lane.
observations.limit: Confirms continued cargo presentation, not a new mechanic or measured progression speed.

observations.observation: Level 3 has greenish cracked ground; a very tall stacked load at a station with a cargo label.
observations.limit: Small labels too soft for reliable capacity transcription; stage theme change is visible.

observations.observation: Level 3 yellow drill-nose vehicle among dense rubble, broken chunks and bright impact effects at ore cells.
observations.limit: Visual frame only: effect density is visible but performance cost and collision/fragment method are unknown.

observations.observation: Level 3 very large yellow dump truck by the hub, separate fuel and cargo readouts; green Completar Nivel button beneath stage progress; small sale truck reads 4/4.
observations.limit: Completion threshold and vehicle unlock conditions are not shown.

observations.observation: A different mode/site heading says Sitio oceanico #03/10, with MAPA button, countdown around 22 minutes, colored status icons and an OIL kiosk with lock; avatar and sale truck still present.
observations.limit: Supports a separate multi-site/timed presentation. Exact event rules, rewards and reset behavior unknown.

observations.observation: Level 4 orange tanker-like truck beside OIL station; green circular interaction icon on cab; character/cart in outlined ground pad; another character below has a ring and bar.
observations.limit: Refueling mechanism and worker status cannot be inferred from a static frame.

observations.observation: Level 5 hub retains refinery/output/sale zones. Tall green bar-shaped load near VENDER pad and blue sale truck displaying 0/8.
observations.limit: Shows loop persistence and a larger displayed truck denominator than early footage, not a verified capacity progression curve.

observations.observation: Level 6 landscape-format capture; giant yellow dump truck with tall blue cargo stack, fuel display and exit-style icon; adjacent glowing receiver marked 85/300; green Completar Nivel control.
observations.limit: Receiver purpose and amount-to-reward conversion unknown; landscape capture does not prove player orientation controls.

observations.observation: Level 7 landscape-format capture; enormous loaded dump truck in narrow mine-edge corridor; blue, dark and red-accented deposit varieties visible.
observations.limit: Different appearance supports stage variety; hardness, price and unlock requirements not measured.

observations.observation: Level 8 pale icy terrain; a heavy machine surrounded by dense bright cyan/white fragments; separate fuel label; event icon at lower right.
observations.limit: Impact debris can visually obscure the vehicle in this frame; no measured frame rate or particle count.

observations.observation: Level 9 on icy ground: large yellow dump truck beside OIL kiosk, red can-shaped items in a marked pad, rails and tire tracks; separate cargo and fuel readouts; home cue 5 m.
observations.limit: This is a visible refueling-area arrangement, not proof of the exact refill transaction.

observations.observation: Level 10 large yellow vehicle combines a bucket-like front and mechanical rear; cargo/fuel readouts and a home indicator at 68 m; long tire tracks on icy ground.
observations.limit: Distance is this frame only, not a required level size. Control response and fuel cost remain unknown.

observations.observation: Level 10 shows 100% and green Completar Nivel button. Character/cart stands beside OIL kiosk and large roller-equipped machine.
observations.limit: Button availability visible; stage-transition reset/persistence behavior not inspected.

observations.observation: Etapa 13 at 5.8%; green block grid with purple ore faces, narrow mined channel, towering cargo, MAX banner and home/distance arrow. Several event/countdown widgets occupy the side HUD.
observations.limit: UI differs from earlier episodes; game version unknown. Do not infer exact season/event rules.

observations.observation: Etapa 13 at 100%; green Completar Etapa button, yellow heavy machine with green interaction marker, large station stack labelled CARGA: 2178, event widgets and a prominent optional rocket-style icon.
observations.limit: Large stored count is a screenshot value, not a recommended simulation count. Stage reset and optional icon effects were not tested.

observations.observation: Stage 2 hub; machinery-rental task, shop entry pad, sold-out-style indicator and cash-spending reward track.
observations.limit: Offer availability and reward-track rules are not established; not a Sprint 1 requirement.

observations.observation: Stage 2 yellow dump/hauling vehicle in a cleared route near green ore; orange gauge, cargo readout and home-distance cue.
observations.limit: No fuel consumption rate, speed, steering or collision measurement.

observations.observation: Equipment upgrade panel separates MINING and CARRYING; a vertical sequence shows a check mark and locked steps.
observations.limit: Reconfirms earlier E07 observation. Exact prerequisite chain and costs not established.
